d: Utopia is an ultra-luxury hospitality and lifestyle brand creating a global ecosystem of properties and experiences.

We develop private villa retreats in beautiful locations around the world, each with high-end service. Utopia also offers a wider ecosystem of leisure experiences and services available both to those staying on property and to external visitors.

Utopia designs and builds its properties in-house. Our projects span the full journey: from concept and architecture to construction, interiors, landscape, guest experience, and long-term operation. For architects and designers, this means contributing on properties from the ground up, with the ability to influence how each place is planned, built, and experienced. For hospitality professionals, it means collaborating with a brand where service is personal, attentive, and built around each guest’s stay.

We’re a young, ambitious team with high standards and a hands-on approach. We value strong ideas, practical thinking, attention to detail, and people who are ready to take ownership of their part of each project. If you’re interested in architecture, design, hospitality, or guest experience, we invite you to explore opportunities with Utopia.

We’re looking for a Head of Delivery to take ownership of Utopia’s entire luxury construction portfolio and build the organization that delivers it. You’ll establish and lead our Project Management Office and construction engineering function, and you’ll be accountable for every project from permits and approvals through execution and final handover: on time, within budget, and to exceptional quality standards. The role is fully remote with business trips, covering projects in the Middle East, Western Europe, Africa, and Latin America.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Architecture, or an equivalent field
10+ years of experience in construction and development delivery, including senior responsibility for multiple projects at the same time
Proven track record delivering luxury residential and hotel or hospitality projects, managed as a portfolio rather than as a single project
Experience building or leading a PMO and a construction engineering function
Hands-on experience with project management tools such as Primavera P6, MS Project, or similar
A hands-on, proactive, and decisive approach: structured, results-oriented, with strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
r: Own delivery of a portfolio of high-end hospitality and luxury residential projects running in parallel, from property acquisition and due diligence through planning, design, permitting, construction, commissioning, and operational handover
Build and lead the Project Management Office (PMO), setting up project governance, planning, reporting, controls, and performance management across all projects
Establish and manage the construction and engineering function, including site engineers, technical supervision, quality control, and construction standards
Hold full accountability for portfolio-wide budgets, schedules, quality, risks, and resource allocation, so that delivery is predictable across every project
Oversee contractors, cost management, and high-end finishing, applying sound technical and commercial judgement to protect quality and budget
Manage relationships with local authorities, consultants, and statutory bodies to secure regulatory approvals without delaying the programme
Lead multidisciplinary teams, build a culture of accountability, and hold project managers, consultants, and contractors responsible for results
Spot problems early, make decisions, and drive corrective actions, rather than simply reporting progress
Give leadership clear, regular reporting on portfolio status, risks, and escalations
x: High-end international projects. Work on premium developments abroad, a valuable addition to any professional portfolio
Upscale clientele. Regular collaboration with high-profile clients brings exposure to demanding standards and valuable professional connections

Project security. The investor is developing each property for their own use as a hospitality venture, which means strong commitment and a guarantee that projects will be carried through to full completion
Fully remote with business trips. You’ll collaborate from anywhere within GMT 0 to GMT+2.
All the tools you need. A laptop, home office supplies and infrastructure, and access to our project and documentation tools from day one
Properties across three continents. You’ll deliver projects in Europe, Africa, the Middle East, and Latin America
A team that spans 30+ countries. Developers, architects, engineers, and legal specialists from every corner of the world, held to the same standards and the same bar for quality

d: Calo is an app providing personalized meal plans for busy people through nutritional algorithms, built with love by chefs, nutritionists, and software engineers.

Launched in Bahrain in 2019, we have since expanded to 7 countries, delivered millions of meals to our customers, and are now expanding our mission of making healthy easy to retail and other verticals.
We're on a noble mission to make healthy easy. We think this is one of the most important problems to tackle in our world today. We have global ambitions - no small thinking here.
We’re looking for a Purchasing & Inventory Officer to manage procurement and inventory operations end-to-end in Riyadh.
This role plays a key part in ensuring product availability, cost efficiency, and smooth warehouse operations to support our daily production.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, or related field
2–3 years of experience in procurement and inventory roles (F&B or FMCG preferred)
Experience using ERP or inventory management systems
Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
Screening meeting with our TA team
r: Source and manage suppliers (local & international) for ingredients, packaging, and services
Ensure timely purchasing aligned with production and demand planning
Track supplier performance, pricing, and cost-saving opportunities
Build strong vendor relationships to ensure consistency and reliability
Stay updated on market trends, especially within the F&B space
Oversee stock control, storage, and inventory accuracy
Maintain real-time inventory records and reduce discrepancies
Ensure proper implementation of FIFO / FEFO practices
Monitor expiry dates, batch tracking, and stock movement
Ensure compliance with food safety and warehouse standards (HACCP)
Work closely with kitchen and production teams to forecast needs
Support material planning and daily stock issuance
Track key KPIs (stock turnover, wastage, availability)
Support audits and continuous process improvements
